details: Contradicted by the full cube: $\mathrm{coVC}=0$ but $\mathrm{VCR}=n$.
proof: For the full cube, every trace is present, so no positive-dimensional hollow star exists and co-VC dimension is zero. Its entire domain is shattered, so its effective VC radius is n. Thus the asserted inequality fails on this family.
name: co-VC dimension / Effective VC Radius
